chunks: Indeed, ʿAlī عليه السلام held a Muslim man liable for the value of a pig belonging to a Christian, which he had damaged.

key_terms.خِنْزِيرًا: a pig, treated here as compensable property belonging to another
key_terms.ضَمَّنَ: held legally liable to provide compensation
key_terms.مُسْلِمًا: a Muslim man subject to the ruling

ai.seo_question: Is a Muslim liable to compensate a non-Muslim for damaging property such as a pig?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling from Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام that a Muslim was required to compensate a Christian for damage done to his pig. It indicates liability for harming another person's property, even when that property is not lawful for the Muslim to use.
